projectData.rawScript:
Basketball Girl

Outline: Three girls exiled from the city to a rural Hunan village after family upheavals clash with a sharp-tongued young teacher who is trying to stay on track for graduate school. When urban basketball skill meets rural raw strength, a conflict sparked by a shattered figurine forces the girls to fight for their dignity on a dusty school court with a single basketball.

Character bios: Maya (17) is the furious sports rep and figurine fanatic. Molly (17) is a meticulous fence-sitter who uses basketball mainly to fit in. Ella (17) is a sharp-tongued top student who resents the rural environment. Serena (22) is a hot-blooded volunteer teacher and former basketball star. Zoe (18) is a repeat student with great physical strength who protects Luna. Luna (16) is a timid girl from a sexist family who pretends to have power by claiming to be the principal's niece.

Episode 1: The Figurine Incident

Scene 1: A battered bus rolls into Qingshi Town.
Scene 2: Maya worships her figurine on the playground.
Scene 3: Zoe shuts down a group of bullies.
Scene 4: A basketball smashes the figurine and sparks a showdown.
Scene 5: Serena turns the fight into a three-on-three challenge.

△ A battered bus lurches along the winding mountain road. Outside the window, terraced fields stretch into the distance. △ Serena sleeps against the seatback until a heavy jolt sends her suitcase popping open and an orange basketball rolling into the aisle.

Villager: Girl, are you here to teach?

△ Serena opens her eyes and picks up the ball with a cool, confident look. The MVP lettering on the ball is already worn down.

Serena: I'm here for graduate school.

△ She stuffs the ball back into her bag and looks out the window. [Subtitle: Hunan · Qingshi Town]

scenes.content:
△ A concrete playground with a wooden backboard whose edges are already cracked. △ Maya carefully places a beautiful NBA player figurine on the basketball stand base and sets down a clean tissue underneath it.

Maya: Please bless me, husband. Today's shooting percentage has to be over fifty.

Molly: (holding a small mirror and reapplying sunscreen) Maya, this sun is so harsh it could peel your skin. That figurine is going to melt.

Ella: (leaning on the hoop while flipping through an English vocabulary book) Based on the UV intensity, that model coating will fade irreversibly within two hours. Maya, your behavior is childish.

Maya: (dribbling, crisp and decisive) Shut up! This is called a spiritual support! Watch closely, and I'll show you what a city-league fadeaway looks like!

△ Maya jumps and shoots. The ball bounces off the rim and flies toward the grass at the edge of the playground.

△ Zoe lies on the grass with her arms behind her head, resting under a straw hat. △ Luna is being surrounded by a few boys who keep snatching her backpack away.

Luna: Give it back! I'll tell my uncle... I'll tell the head teacher!

Boy: Go ahead! Fake niece! Where's your repeat-student cousin? Tell her to come out here!

△ The basketball slams down by the boy's feet with a sharp thud. △ Zoe pushes the straw hat up and sits up, her eyes cold like a wolf's.

Zoe: Pick up the ball.

△ The boys exchange glances, intimidated by Zoe's presence, and scatter after dumping the backpack. △ Luna quickly picks up the ball and tosses it backward.

Luna: Who throws a ball like that? So rude!

scenes.sceneHeader: 1-4 Day Exterior Under the Basketball Hoop  Characters: Everyone
scenes.content:
△ The ball arcs awkwardly but lands perfectly on the hoop base. △ With a sharp pop, the figurine is struck, the clear cover snaps off, and the head rolls across the concrete.

△ Maya freezes in place. The world stands still for three seconds.

Maya: (screaming) My husband—!

△ She rushes over and picks up the decapitated figurine, her eyes turning red instantly.

Maya: (pointing at Luna) You pay! Do you know this is a collector's item?!

Luna: (ducking behind Zoe in fear) Who told you to put a toy there... this is a playground!

Molly: (putting away her mirror, voice sharp) Wow, break someone's stuff and you still act tough? Don't think your name gives you backup.

Ella: (closing her book and walking over coldly) Deliberately damaging someone else's property over five hundred yuan can be reported. Maya, stop talking and make her pay.

△ Zoe steps in front of Luna. She is half a head taller than Maya and radiates the explosive strength of years of farm work.

Zoe: My sister threw the ball. If you want money, we don't have any.

Maya: No money? Then get on your knees and apologize to it!

△ Maya shoves her. Zoe doesn't budge.

scenes.sceneHeader: 1-5 Day Exterior Center of the Playground  Characters: Everyone, Serena
scenes.content:
△ Maya swings the basketball straight at Zoe. △ Zoe blocks it with one hand and grabs the ball. She has never trained formally, but her reactions are lightning fast.

Zoe: If you have strength, keep it for work.

△ Zoe dribbles. Her form is rough, but her speed is astonishing as she drives straight to the hoop. △ Maya cuts her off from the side and the two collide. Zoe feels like a steel plate; Maya is bounced right back.

△ Zoe jumps and slams the ball hard into the rim. △ Because she used too much force, the basketball ricochets upward.

Serena: (appearing suddenly and catching the falling ball overhead) Your form is failing, but your explosiveness is solid.

△ Everyone stares. Serena is in a simple white T-shirt, riding a shared bicycle, and a whistle peeks out of her bag.

Serena: I'm the new PE teacher.

Maya: (wiping away tears, unconvinced) A teacher? She broke my figurine!

Serena: I can see that. So your idea of solving problems here is just fighting?

△ Serena looks at Maya, then at Zoe.

Serena: Fine. Since you all think you're so capable, let's do three-on-three.

Serena: (pointing at Zoe) You. Go find two more people.

Serena: (looking at Maya) You three, stop embarrassing yourselves under the banner of being from the city.

Serena: Whoever loses will wash all the school's sports equipment for a month, and the losing side must apologize publicly.

Maya: (gritting her teeth) Bring it on! You rural bumpkin!

Zoe: (coldly) Whatever.

△ Serena tosses the ball to Maya, a playful smile tugging at her lips.

Serena: Tomorrow afternoon. This hoop.

projectBackground.title: Basketball Girl
projectBackground.outline: Three young girls who were "exiled" from big cities and returned to a mountain village in Hunan due to family changes. With their incompatible arrogance and loss, they accidentally bumped into a "prickly" female teacher who wanted to secure a graduate degree. When urban basketball technology meets the strange power of rural wild people, in the conflict caused by broken figures, these girls who have been exiled from life decide to win back their dignity with a basketball on the dusty playground.
projectBackground.characterBios: Maya (17): Irritated physical committee/figure fiend. Strong and outspoken, extremely insecure, he regards football star figures as his lifeblood. Molly (17): A drama queen. He is thoughtful, precocious and sensitive. He is good at pretending to be stupid and plays basketball just to join the group. Ella (17): A venomous scholar. He is arrogant, wants to be strong in everything, and is full of resistance to the rural environment. Serena (22): A passionate teacher. Graduate of a prestigious university, former main player of the basketball team, rebellious and unruly. Zoe (18): A "wild child" who repeated a grade. Cold on the outside and hot on the inside, with excellent physical fitness, Luna is regarded as her only guardian. Luna (16): A little expert in complaining. A victim of a timid and patriarchal family, the bluff "director's niece".

episodeRawScripts.title: Episode 1: The Figurine Incident
episodeRawScripts.rawContent:
Basketball Girl

Outline: Three girls exiled from the city to a rural Hunan village after family upheavals clash with a sharp-tongued young teacher who is trying to stay on track for graduate school. When urban basketball skill meets rural raw strength, a conflict sparked by a shattered figurine forces the girls to fight for their dignity on a dusty school court with a single basketball.

Ella (17) is a sharp-tongued top student who resents the rural environment. Serena (22) is a hot-blooded volunteer teacher and former basketball star. Zoe (18) is a repeat student with great physical strength who protects Luna. Luna (16) is a timid girl from a sexist family who pretends to have power by claiming to be the principal's niece.

scenes.content:
△ The ball arcs awkwardly but lands perfectly on the hoop base. △ With a sharp pop, the figurine is struck, the clear cover snaps off, and the head rolls across the concrete.

△ Maya freezes in place. The world stands still for three seconds.

Maya: (screaming) My husband—!

△ She rushes over and picks up the decapitated figurine, her eyes turning red instantly.

Maya: (pointing at Luna) You pay! Do you know this is a collector's item?!

Luna: (ducking behind Zoe in fear) Who told you to put a toy there... this is a playground!

Molly: (putting away her mirror, voice sharp) Wow, break someone's stuff and you still act tough? Don't think your name gives you backup.

Ella: (closing her book and walking over coldly) Deliberately damaging someone else's property over five hundred yuan can be reported. Maya, stop talking and make her pay.

△ Zoe steps in front of Luna. She is half a head taller than Maya and radiates the explosive strength of years of farm work.

Zoe: My sister threw the ball. If you want money, we don't have any.

Maya: No money? Then get on your knees and apologize to it!

△ Maya shoves her. Zoe doesn't budge.

scenes.content:
△ Maya swings the basketball straight at Zoe. △ Zoe blocks it with one hand and grabs the ball. She has never trained formally, but her reactions are lightning fast.

Zoe: If you have strength, keep it for work.

△ Zoe dribbles. Her form is rough, but her speed is astonishing as she drives straight to the hoop. △ Maya cuts her off from the side and the two collide. Zoe feels like a steel plate; Maya is bounced right back.

△ Zoe jumps and slams the ball hard into the rim. △ Because she used too much force, the basketball ricochets upward.

Serena: (appearing suddenly and catching the falling ball overhead) Your form is failing, but your explosiveness is solid.

△ Everyone stares. Serena is in a simple white T-shirt, riding a shared bicycle, and a whistle peeks out of her bag.

Serena: I'm the new PE teacher.

Maya: (wiping away tears, unconvinced) A teacher? She broke my figurine!

Serena: I can see that. So your idea of solving problems here is just fighting?

△ Serena looks at Maya, then at Zoe.

Serena: Fine. Since you all think you're so capable, let's do three-on-three.

Serena: (pointing at Zoe) You. Go find two more people.

Serena: (looking at Maya) You three, stop embarrassing yourselves under the banner of being from the city.

Serena: Whoever loses will wash all the school's sports equipment for a month, and the losing side must apologize publicly.

Maya: (gritting her teeth) Bring it on! You rural bumpkin!

Zoe: (coldly) Whatever.

△ Serena tosses the ball to Maya, a playful smile tugging at her lips.

Serena: Tomorrow afternoon. This hoop.

## Story Outline
Three girls exiled from the city to a rural Hunan village after family upheavals clash with a sharp-tongued young teacher who is trying to stay on track for graduate school. Maya (17): A fierce sports rep and figurine fanatic. Molly (17): A meticulous fence-sitter who uses basketball mainly to fit in.
